publisherDefines: Caller supplies the original notification ID from the list.
Detail returns native ID, three subject strings, three message strings, schedule/expiry integers and source ID.
Message fields carry structured text, image and link content.
observedFraming: Complete fixed NotiDetail JSONP wrapper, not ordinary JSON
timestampQualification: The list section states milliseconds, while the detail section states microseconds; observed detail integers are retained without unit conversion or currentness inference.
pilotConcurrencyIncident: One direct detail pilot overlapped the two existing lanes; no more live source tests before pausing a lane. Subsequent implementation and replay are offline.
adapterPolicy: Preserve message strings; do not render content or fetch secondary links.
